notes: v1.1.114: Page system right-click now matches the Browser grid - smart Select / Highlight / Deselect (all, by status, invert), Check (Proxy / Cookie / UID), Pages, Proxy and Move to folder, plus Login FB > Login With Browser which opens the account already logged in (its saved cookie is seeded first) and tiles the windows. A new Stop button halts a running Page batch, 'Switch into page' and the old 'Check account' button are gone, and the account list no longer freezes while refreshing a large batch. Hotmail 'View IMAP' now actually brings the IMAP window to the front instead of opening it hidden. Account unlock resends its email code at a human pace (40-60s apart, no more rapid-fire) and reads the Hotmail token first; it uses the 'email on the ID' unlock option instead of picking the wrong method. A Like is only counted when the button really toggles (a label that merely carries a reaction count no longer reads as a false success). WideWarp order services (reaction, comment, review, follower, group, video) are wired across Browser, Page and ADB, and the admin panel shows each customer's note, comments and reviews. Carries 1.1.113 (login uses the app's own emu2 browser, any-language 2FA) and earlier.
